futureDescription: We are confident that one day in the near future, Urhobo will become the official language of the Urhobo Nation, taught in schools and spoken in Urhobo communities with pride and love. Together, we can create the Urhobo world.

languageDescription: The Urhobo language is a beautiful, expressive, tonal language that, unfortunately, has not been spoken officially in the Urhobo Nation for many years. Consequently, over time, parts of the language have been forgotten, and sadly lost.
missionDescription: Guọnọ is a tech startup dedicated to providing services in the Urhobo language. Our goal is to help revive, promote, and document the Urhobo language.
